question: Who among the following persuaded Mahatma Gandhi to allow women to join the Salt Satyagraha movement?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kamaladevi Chattopadhyay **was an **Indian social reformer** and **freedom activist.**
 
• One of the women who is credited with **convincing Gandhiji** to allow **women's involvement **in the **Salt Satyagraha movement **was Kamaladevi.
 
• She was a member of the **seven-person leadership team** in the renowned **Salt Satyagraha (1930).**
 
• The team was tasked with preparing salt on the **Bombay beachfront.**
 
• **Avantikabai Gokhale** was the only other woman on the team who volunteered.
 
• She received the **Sangeet Natak Academy Fellowship** in** 1974.**
 
• The Indian government awarded her the** Padma Bhushan and Padma Vibhushan** in **1955 and 1987**, respectively.
 
• Because of her contributions to the handloom industry, she is known as **Hatkargha Maa**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Annie Besant:**

 
 
• British socialist Annie Besant was also an **advocate** for **women's rights, home rule, and theosophy.**
 
• She was a** fierce advocate **for both** Irish and Indian independence.**
 
• For** fifteen years,** Besant actively promoted **scientific materialism **and **atheism in England.**
 
 
 
• **Ashalata Sen:**
 
 
• Ashalata Sen was a prominent member of the** Indian independence struggle** as well as an** activist, poet, and social worker.**
 
 
 
• **Ambabai:**
 
 
• Ambabai was a native of **Karnataka.**
 
• She was** twelve** when she **got married** and **sixteen** when she** lost her husband.**
 
• She then got involved in the** fight for Indian independence.**
 
• She protested at** booze and foreign clothing **stores in Udipi.
